title: Any ideas on how they filmed the subjects with reflective glasses in the 2015 “Everest” film?

commenti.body:
Haven’t seen Everest, but if I had to guess from what you described, they could be using a tilt shift lens. This video gives a good rundown: [https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=ZlaeWRMYwGg](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=ZlaeWRMYwGg) 

This video gives a great rundown on hiding from mirrored surfaces using other techniques: [https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=VASwKZAUVSo](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=VASwKZAUVSo) [spoiler: bunch of CGI]
